sage.label: GraphSAGE
sage.looks_for: As-of caught-propagation over the person graph, ignoring edge types. Best/representative GNN arm; the one the hybrid fuses.

rgcn.label: RGCN full graph
rgcn.looks_for: As-of caught-propagation over typed COTRAVEL, RESIDENCE, SHARED_PLATE, SHARED_PLATE_HOT relations.

gat.label: GAT (attention)
gat.looks_for: As-of caught-propagation with attention over neighbors.

gin.label: GIN
gin.looks_for: As-of caught-propagation with a high-expressivity GIN.
